## RS Email Signature EasyComms

Webhook receives `email_signature.send_requested` from RS_Tool-Email-Signature.

Set the Email Signature app env:

EASYCOMMS_WEBHOOK_URL=<production webhook URL>
EASYCOMMS_WEBHOOK_TOKEN=<optional shared bearer token>

After import, select a Gmail credential in the Send Signature Email node, activate the workflow, then copy the production webhook URL into the Email Signature app env.
